findings.title: Error-recovery is a single pivot phrase
findings.body: T1's whole recovery hinges on two short clauses — Reflection › Inspect Error Pattern ("a data model issue") immediately followed by Deciding › Pick alternative strategy ("query the database directly") — the quote view shows the pydantic failure handled in one sentence.

findings.title: Recall spans four tool domains
findings.body: The Memory › Read from working memory tags at T2/T5/T6 reference facts first established in different skills (airline DB, car inventory, Word doc), showing cross-domain working memory rather than within-skill recall.

findings.title: No-op correctly remembered
findings.body: T2's "nothing to change" conclusion is itself recalled at T5 ("no changes were made because the names already matched") — the agent remembers a non-action, not just data values.
